messages:
maya: Heads-up: sample-app (mobile) created noisy errors in Sentry this morning. Root cause looks like 401 -> retry loop, but SDK surfaced a generic string so alerts grouped it wrong.

liam: Can you paste the error payload you saw?

maya: Sure — here's the payload the SDK emitted:```json
{
  "error": "Auth failure",
  "code": 401,
  "message": "invalid token"
}
```

nisha: Oof. Our error-shape doc encouraged typed exceptions with machine fields (retryable, retry_after_ms, action) but not all SDKs implemented them.

liam: Suggestion: agree on a minimal typed shape we can guarantee across SDKs: `name`, `http_status`, `machine_code`, `retry_hint` (enum: `retry_immediate|retry_backoff|refresh_credentials|no_retry`), `retry_after_ms`, `public_message`, `trace_id`.

sam: +1. If we include `trace_id` / `request_id` in the emitted error object that makes Sentry/Prod debugging way easier. Also `public_message` lets the app show a clear UX copy without leaking internals.

maya: Repro notes: mobile uses JS SDK v1.2.0 which maps 401 -> AuthError (string), no retry_hint. If we changed to emit `AuthExpired` with `retry_hint: refresh_credentials` and `public_message: "Session expired, please sign in again."` Sentry grouping will separate it.

nisha: For status mapping guidance: 401 should often map to `refresh_credentials`. 403 -> `no_retry` (permission issue). 429 -> `retry_backoff` with `retry_after_ms` from header. 5xx -> `retry_backoff` but flag as server-side.

sam: Also add `sdk_generated: true` boolean so downstream classifiers know it came from SDK normalization. And include a short example snippet for sample-apps:```js
// recommended error normalization
throw new SDKError({
  name: 'AuthExpired',
  http_status: 401,
  retry_hint: 'refresh_credentials',
  public_message: 'Session expired. Sign in to continue',
  trace_id: ctx.requestId
})
```

liam: I'll put together a PR that changes JS + Go SDKs to emit that shape. We should also include a migration note for Sentry so we don't accidentally re-alert on historical 401s.

ops-bot: deploy-check: sample-app branch `fix/auth-error-shape` queued for CI (build #482).

nisha: I'll update the devex docs and the sample-app recipe (mobile) to show how to wire UI messaging from `public_message`. ETA: EOD tomorrow. @liam can you lead the SDK change?

liam: Yep — will open RFC + PR today and add unit tests and a small sample-app commit to demo the UX flow.

maya: Thanks team. After the change let's run a quick Sentry reclassification so the alerts quiet down.

sam: Side note: we should also add an e2e test that simulates auth refresh failing vs succeeding so we don't regress again.

nisha: Agreed — adding to the ticket.

maya: I'll post a short postmortem in #incidents with the timeline once CI lands.
